variables.name: Next.js Version
variables.description: Next.js version used only when the egg creates a brand new project (no package.json yet), for example 'latest' or '16.4.6'. Existing projects keep the version in their own package.json.

variables.name: Next.js Updates
variables.description: Keep Next.js updated on every start so security fixes land automatically. 'patch' (default) updates within your current minor version, for example 16.4.3 to 16.4.6. 'minor' updates within your current major version. 'off' never changes Next.js. Only Next.js is updated, your lockfile is kept, and it never jumps to a new major version. Skipped when Auto Update pulls from git.

variables.name: Node ENV
variables.description: Runtime mode for Next.js command: use 'start' for production or 'dev' for development.

variables.name: Package Manager
variables.description: Choose package manager: auto (detect by lockfile), npm, pnpm, or yarn.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Optional: repository to clone on the first start, when the server is still empty.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull from git on startup (0 for false, 1 for true)

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Token for private repositories. For a GitHub fine-grained token, give it read access to Contents of this repository.
